text: 【吴清：新经济领域公司数量、市值在全市场占比超一半】11月14日，证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，A股5500多家上市公司中，新经济领域公司数量、营收、市值在全市场占比均超过一半。同时，上市公司回报投资者意识和能力有效提升，新“国九条”颁布近两年多来，上市公司分红近7万亿，约为同期股权融资的3倍，回购注销成为一些上市公司的常态化选择。
text_en: [Wu Qing: Companies in new economy sectors account for more than half of the total number and market value of the whole market] On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that among the more than 5,500 A-share listed companies, companies in new economy sectors account for more than half of the whole market in terms of number, revenue and market value. At the same time, listed companies' awareness and ability to reward investors have effectively improved. In the more than two years since the new "Nine National Guidelines" were issued, listed companies have distributed nearly RMB 7 trillion in dividends, about three times equity financing in the same period, and repurchase and cancellation have become a regular choice for some listed companies.
